Messages.Body:
My question concerns the master card Mob Connections, while in play can
a player tap the card and give a press to a combat that doesn't involve
him/her? Players in my group mentioned that the text doesn't specify
but I remember a similar ruling concerning another master card
(elysium) where it was ruled that a player could not tap the card if
they were not part of the combat...

In this case (mob connections) the player used it to prolong combat
between two players not really wanting to fight (i guess it seems it
worse then...)

thank you

Mob Connections

Unique Master. Tap to give a press, only usable to continue combat, to
a vampire you control. Any minion may burn this card as a (D) action.
